messages.subject: Environmental data upload
parts:
Hi, 
I have a question about using Wallace module 3.
I wonder if I can load my user-specified rasters and worldclim Bioclims data at the same time.
I;d like to consider the raster and bioclime at the same time.
I look forward to your kind answer!

messages.author: d73691b565754184
messages.subject: Re: Environmental data upload
parts:
Hello Je Hyeok Ryu,

It is not possible to use both kinds of data at the same time on Wallace. My suggestions are i) downloading Worldclim data, ii) create a folder with all your rasters (User-raster + Worldclim; be aware that they need to have the same resolution, extend, and datum), iii) upload them on Wallace using the user-specified module.

Let me know if this works for you.

Best,
Gonzalo

You are right, there is no way to save your progress once an error happened. It looks like there is an option to save your progress in Shiny applications, but we are not planning to add that in the upcoming version. I will push forward this idea; hopefully, this option will be available next year.

Best,
